_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); cable signals

pit_profile.why: 'We are a leading provider of video, high-speed Internet and phone services (“cable services”)' (FY2009 10-K); 'Competition for the cable services we offer consists primarily of direct broadcast satellite (“DBS”) operators and phone companies'; 'new services and technologies that may compete with our video services include online services that offer Internet video streaming, downloading and distribution of movies, television shows and other video programming'; 'Weak economic conditions persisted during 2009'

classification.quality_note: 'We are a leading provider of video, high-speed Internet and phone services (“cable services”)' (FY2009 10-K); 'Competition for the cable services we offer consists primarily of direct broadcast satellite (“DBS”) operators and phone companies'; 'new services and technologies that may compete with our video services include online services that offer Internet video streaming, downloading and distribution of movies, television shows and other video programming'; 'Weak economic conditions persisted during 2009'. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price cheap; Ratio B 0.08x; -9% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap +0.86; conservative 2yr +105%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -10.7%/yr (worst year FY04-FY09, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +10.5%/yr (Q3 revenues + margin + buyback); P/E at its 7.1-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +35.1%/yr (FY04-FY09 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +72.0%/yr (best 2-yr run FY04-FY09); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: CMCSA (retrospective, 2011-01-28) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.08x (47.5% downside to Bear $12 / +574.3% upside to Bull $154) | Adj composite 2.08 vs market 1.22: gap +0.86 [UNDERVALUED] | -9% above the EPP floor $25 (20x FY10E $1.26) | Conservative 2-yr case: +104.7% total (+52.4%/yr) | At 18.1x FY10E the 15% hurdle price $30 sits at or below the BASE case; video subscribers -3.5% in Q3 2010, forward revenues +7.3% (no FY10 revenue guide in numbers, Q3 2010 revenue growth); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
